debt_amount.meaning: amount borrowed in the short (debt) position of the Delayed Swap
debt_amount.checkpoint: before risk engine computes delayed swap collateral

credit_amount.meaning: amount lent in the credit (long) position of the Delayed Swap
credit_amount.checkpoint: before risk engine computes delayed swap collateral

required_collateral.meaning: collateral requirement computed for the loan (debt) portion
required_collateral.checkpoint: before risk engine computes delayed swap collateral

converted_credit.meaning: converted credit amount compared against required collateral
converted_credit.checkpoint: before risk engine computes delayed swap collateral

collateral_reduced_by_credit.meaning: holding the credit position reduces the collateral requirement of the loan rather than increasing it
collateral_reduced_by_credit.checkpoint: after risk engine computes delayed swap collateral

strategy_unviable.meaning: the hedged Delayed Swap strategy is rendered economically unviable (DoS of functionality)
strategy_unviable.checkpoint: after risk engine computes delayed swap collateral

assumptions: debt_amount and credit_amount are the report's 100 ETH and 105 ETH figures at the pre-computation checkpoint
converted_credit and required_collateral are the report's 105 and 100 values at the pre-computation checkpoint

unresolved.description: The intent states credit should reduce the collateral requirement (a directional reduction relation), but the report supplies no numeric definition of the reduced collateral amount; the reduction is encoded as a grounded Boolean relation rather than a quantified value.
The impact 'economically unviable (DoS of functionality)' is stated as a potential qualitative outcome with no observable numeric or state definition; encoded as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The intent's 'reduce rather than increase' is represented by the grounded Boolean collateral_reduced_by_credit; the exact reduced collateral value is not defined in the report.
The impact is potential/qualitative and is bound to a derived Boolean pending stage-3 observability binding.

links.reported_relation: When convertedCredit exceeds required, the flawed max logic returns the larger credit as collateral instead of reducing it, penalizing hedged strategies and making them economically unviable.
